_comment: A3114 / A2031: the three workshop stages, defined once. A page's existing difficulty maps to one stage. Use this rubric when writing a new workshop or measuring a subject's progression gap. Do not relabel an existing workshop to fill a gap; add the missing stage.

Beginner.does: Makes a small, complete thing by following a guided step.
Beginner.support: Every step is named, one concept at a time, with a check before moving on.
Beginner.evidence: A first playable build, saved file or finished project the learner can show.
Beginner.adult: No grown-up needed for the browser lane.

Builder.does: Combines the beginner ideas into a bigger project and makes at least one choice of their own.
Builder.support: The goal and the checkpoints are given; the learner chooses some parts and fixes small mistakes.
Builder.evidence: An extended project with one original feature, plus a short note on what changed.
Builder.adult: A grown-up may help with an install or an account.

Creator.does: Plans a project from a brief, builds it independently and debugs it without a step-by-step guide.
Creator.support: Only the outcome, constraints and reference material are given.
Creator.evidence: A complete project, a design note and a shared or exported build.
Creator.adult: Independent; a grown-up may review the finished work.
